title: Attention Is All You Need
abstract_snippet: We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.

title: Gödel Machines: Fully Self-Referential Optimal Universal Self-Improvers
abstract_snippet: We present the first class of mathematically rigorous, general, fully self-referential, self-improving, optimally efficient problem solvers.

title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
abstract_snippet: We propose Reflexion, an approach that endows agents with dynamic memory and self-reflection capabilities to improve reasoning and decision-making.

title: Darwin Gödel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents
abstract_snippet: We present the Darwin Gödel Machine, an open-ended self-improving agent that rewrites its own code guided by empirical evaluation.

title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
abstract_snippet: We introduce Adam, an algorithm for first-order gradient-based optimization of stochastic objective functions, based on adaptive estimates of lower-order moments.

title: AI Safety via Debate
abstract_snippet: To increase the robustness of AI systems, we propose training agents via self-play on a zero-sum debate game with a human judge.

title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
abstract_snippet: Constitutional AI trains models to be harmless using a list of principles (a constitution) and AI feedback, reducing reliance on human labels for harmlessness.

title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
abstract_snippet: Voyager uses an LLM-driven automatic curriculum, a skill library, and iterative prompting to explore Minecraft open-endedly.

title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
abstract_snippet: Self-Refine improves LLM outputs by generating feedback on its own outputs and refining iteratively, without additional training.

title: Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning for Fast Adaptation of Deep Networks (MAML)
abstract_snippet: MAML learns an initialization that can be quickly adapted to new tasks with few gradient steps.

title: Auto-GPT: An Autonomous GPT-4 Experiment
abstract_snippet: Auto-GPT popularized autonomous LLM agent loops that decompose goals into tasks, use tools, and iterate without continuous human prompting.

title: OpenDevin: An Open Platform for AI Software Developers as Generalist Agents
abstract_snippet: OpenDevin (now OpenHands) is an open platform for software engineering agents that interact with code, terminals, and browsers.

title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
abstract_snippet: Generative agents simulate believable human behavior in an interactive sandbox using memory, reflection, and planning.
